description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'CombinedDisplayField' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField'. The class serves as a base for display field components in the OrangeHRM reporting system, specifying methods for retrieving DTO class names, entity aliases, and field lists, as well as constructing a SQL select part string.

classes.name: CombinedDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract class for combined display fields used in reporting, implementing the DisplayField interface, with methods to generate parts of a SQL select statement.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Empty constructor, final to prevent overriding.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the associated Data Transfer Object class name.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve entity aliases relevant for the display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the list of database fields used.

methods.name: getSelectPart
methods.description: Constructs and returns a SQL expression string for selecting data, combining DTO class and fields.
